plugin.name: Automatic_Backup
plugin.author: Fiendish
plugin.purpose: Backs up the world file to a new name each day
plugin.description: Saves a backup of your world file.

muclient.script:
require "aard_lua_ffi"
function do_backup () local world_file_path = GetInfo(54) local max_backups = 7 -- Maximum number of backups to keep
if saving or (not world_file_path) or (world_file_path == "") then return end
saving = true
-- Get the world file name without the path local world_file_name = string.match(world_file_path, "([^/\\]+)$")
-- Create backup directory if it doesn't exist local backup_dir = GetInfo(67) .. "world_backups\\" .. world_file_name:gsub("%.[Mm][Cc][Ll]$", "\\") aard_lua_ffi.CreateDirectory(backup_dir, true)
local world_file_with_date = backup_dir .. world_file_name:gsub("%.[Mm][Cc][Ll]$", "") .. os.date (".mcl.backup-%d-%b-%Y") if Save(world_file_with_date, true) == false then ColourNote ("orange","", "World file backed up as " .. world_file_with_date) else return end
-- Get a list of existing backup files local backup_files = aard_lua_ffi.ListFiles(backup_dir, world_file_name:gsub("%.[Mm][Cc][Ll]$", "%.mcl%.backup-.*"))
-- Remove oldest backups if there are more than max_backups while #backup_files > max_backups do os.remove(backup_files[#backup_files]) table.remove(backup_files) end
saving = false end
function OnPluginInstall () do_backup () end
function OnPluginWorldSave () do_backup () end
